scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service canceled 34 days ago, which is outside the standard 30-day refund window.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Tanisha Jefferson and I'm 64. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?
Okay, I see. Can you tell me your account number so I can look into this?
Thanks. I see the charge here. Like you said, it's been 34 days, and our policy is 30 days. I can't really do anything about that.
I understand that is the policy, but I was traveling and unable to access my account. Is there a manager I could speak with, or perhaps an exception due to the circumstances?
I don't have access to override the system for that. I'll have to send this to the billing department to see if they want to deal with it. You'll hear back in 3-5 business days.
Oh, that's frustrating. Is there no way to resolve it while I'm on the line?
Like I said, I'm just an agent. I've already put the request in the queue. Is there anything else?

escalation_reason: Agent failed to exercise discretionary authority or provide a clear path to resolution, defaulting to an unnecessary escalation to the billing department.
